title: Perplexity SEO Audit: About 4,310 Bot Fetches, 2 Sessions
meta_description: Perplexity SEO audit on our own site: about 4,310 successful PerplexityBot fetches in 30 days, requests asking for .env files and 2 GA4 sessions in 28 days.

image.takeaway: About 4,310 successful PerplexityBot fetches in 30 days. GA4 credited Perplexity with 2 sessions in 28 days.
image.alt: Hero card for a Perplexity SEO audit: requests labeled PerplexityBot got about 4,310 successful responses on imisofts.com in the 30 days to 5 November 2026, and GA4 credited perplexity.ai with 2 sessions from 8 October to 4 November 2026.
